en.html: Abandoned for years. Who knew when the roof might fall? Probably why it was off-limits—◆no. That too, yes, but not the actual problem. If Suzukawa was right, this might be the culprit's base. Surely nobody was sleeping here... but even that couldn't be ruled out. Walking straight in did not seem particularly clever. My attempt to stop him made no difference. Suzukawa kept approaching the building. The three left behind looked at each other. Hesitation and confusion. Same on every face. At length, Tadayasu shrugged and followed. Konatsu and I came a step behind. ...This far already. Better make up our minds, then.
en.text:
Abandoned for years. Who knew when the roof might fall? Probably why it was off-limits—◆no. That too, yes, but not the actual problem.

If Suzukawa was right, this might be the culprit's base. Surely nobody was sleeping here... but even that couldn't be ruled out.

Walking straight in did not seem particularly clever.

My attempt to stop him made no difference. Suzukawa kept approaching the building.

The three left behind looked at each other.

Hesitation and confusion. Same on every face.

At length, Tadayasu shrugged and followed. Konatsu and I came a step behind.

...This far already. Better make up our minds, then.

ja.html: 放置されてもう長いのだ。 　いつ屋根が落ちるやら知れたものではない。だから 立ち入り禁止なのだろうし――◆いや。それもそうだが、 そういう問題じゃない。 　鈴川の読みが的を射ていれば、ここは犯人の用いる 犯行拠点なのかもしれないのだ。 　まさかここで寝泊りしているということはあるまい が……そんな可能性とて捨て切れたものでもなかろう。 　無造作に踏み込むのが賢いとは思えなかった。 　しかし鈴川はおれの制止に構わず、建物へ近づいて いく。 　残った三人、顔を見合わせる。 　逡巡と困惑が共通して在った。 　やがて、忠保がひとつ肩をすくめ、鈴川の後を追う。 　一歩遅れて、おれと小夏も続いた。 　……ここまで来たら、もう腹を決めるしかないか。

そういう問題じゃない。

　鈴川の読みが的を射ていれば、ここは犯人の用いる
犯行拠点なのかもしれないのだ。
　まさかここで寝泊りしているということはあるまい

　無造作に踏み込むのが賢いとは思えなかった。
　しかし鈴川はおれの制止に構わず、建物へ近づいて
いく。

　残った三人、顔を見合わせる。
　逡巡と困惑が共通して在った。

　やがて、忠保がひとつ肩をすくめ、鈴川の後を追う。

　……ここまで来たら、もう腹を決めるしかないか。

en.html:
Dust.
Mold.
The dry smell of rotting timber.

Expected those. Prepared for those.

But what was this sour stench, crushing every other smell beneath it?

Something like it, I knew. A familiar smell.

At home. At school. Even in the street.

Little by little, my eyes adjusted to the dimness.

Little by little, my eyes adjusted to the dimness.

　だが。
　それら全ての匂いを押し潰し、圧倒的な存在を誇る、
この<ruby>饐<rt>す</rt></ruby>えた臭気は――果たして、何なのか。

　似たような匂いを知ってはいた。
　ごく身近な匂いだ。
　家庭で。学校で。あるいは路上で。

　室内の薄暗さに、少しずつ眼が慣れてくる。

No need to tell us that.

Why were we standing here discussing it? Because nobody wanted to open one, obviously.

Bad smell, good contents—that was kusaya, cheese, durian. About the limit. Generally, what produced a stench was not something a human being wanted.

But Suzukawa wasn't here. Wandering about carelessly, no desire for that either. Check the smell's source, and what other constructive option was left?

Standing about waiting wasn't comfortable.

...Ah, fine.

en.html:
Very cautiously, I approached the boxes.

A whole crowd of rats might come flying out. Would rather they didn't.

Plastic boxes. No locks. The lids seemed merely laid on top.

Easy to open.

Not delighted.

I tapped the side with a finger.

A faint splash.

Tadayasu's nose had apparently been correct.

Hand on the rim. One deep breath, then held it.

I pulled the lid open.

en.html:
Nearly.

I nearly collapsed there.

What!?
What was this smell?

A stench... no.
Not that.
Nothing as simple as that.

Violence.
Violence by smell. A smell that struck.

So appallingly foul that recognition came a moment late. Like touching a boiling kettle without knowing it was hot.

Didn't know this smell.
No, I did...

Which!?

...This smell, no. But a smell that became like this, that I knew.

It was.
It was.

Was the smell shaking my brain as well?

The room tilted. I staggered.

Seeking support, I caught the box's rim with one hand.

Wrong place, apparently. The box turned over at once, throwing its contents across the floor.

en.html:
Konatsu was shouting something.

Aah, so noisy. In the way of my thinking. See, now I'd forgotten what I'd been thinking!

What was it, what was it.

Yes, uniform. Uniform and bag.
What else. What else could I see.

Something between the folds of the uniform.
What was that.

Damn it, who was waving a hand in front of my eyes? In the way.

Tadayasu? No. He was sitting on the floor. What was he doing? His trousers would get dirty.

Couldn't see, damn it.
Whose hand!

Oh. Mine.

In the way. Move.
I wanted to see what was there.

And my neck! Stop turning away on your own!
Look properly.

What was there.
What was there.

The uniform.
What it held.
